# RummyDex

> Your trusted bridge to the best mobile card games. Explore RummyDex for hands-on reviews, real-time news, and complete app knowledge.

## Core Pages
- [Home](https://www.rummydex.com/): Main catalog directory and search.
- [New Apps](https://www.rummydex.com/new-apps): Newly listed applications.
- [Categories](https://www.rummydex.com/categories): Browse applications by category.
- [News](https://www.rummydex.com/news): News articles and updates.
- [Videos](https://www.rummydex.com/videos): Video gallery and previews.
- [Developers](https://www.rummydex.com/developers): Developer directory and portal.
- [FAQ](https://www.rummydex.com/faq): Frequently asked questions.
- [About](https://www.rummydex.com/about): Platform information.
- [Contact](https://www.rummydex.com/contact): Contact information.

- [News Sitemap](https://www.rummydex.com/sitemap-news.xml)
